notes: Tap-to-select. Prompt: 'Tap the red one!' 1 correct item (red-ball.png), 3 distractors (blue-ball.png, yellow-ball.png, green-apple.png). Label each item with only its colour as a single word: Red, Blue, Yellow, Green. Do NOT use compound labels like 'Red Ball'. The single-word colour label is intentional — this activity tests colour vocabulary, not object names.
